description: Implement the complete Settings & Configuration module with all five sub-sections: Organization Settings, Pipeline Configuration, User Management, Integration Settings, and Notification Preferences. Uses tab navigation pattern consistent with Analytics and PlacementTracker pages.
steps: Create src/data/seedSettings.js with comprehensive mock data including: organization profile (name: 'Propela Healthcare', logo placeholder, contact details, default currency ZAR/GBP, fiscal year April-March, branding colors), pipeline stages array (Application Received, Document Verification, OET Preparation, OET Exam, CBT Preparation, CBT Exam, NMC Registration, Visa Processing, Placement Matching, Onboarding), stage transition rules, default durations/SLAs, notification configs per stage, users array (4+ users with roles: Admin/Manager/Recruiter/Read-only), role permissions matrix (access per module), user activity log (10+ mock entries), API keys (3 mock keys with status), webhooks config, integrations list (OET Portal, NHS Jobs, LinkedIn with connected/disconnected status), import/export settings, notification preferences (email toggles per event type, in-app settings, digest frequency, quiet hours)
Add getSettings/saveSettings functions to src/lib/storage.js following the existing pattern (getData/setData with seed initialization in initializeData)
Add settings state to src/context/AppContext.jsx following the existing pattern - import getSettings/saveSettings, add useState/useCallback for settings, include in value object

Create src/components/settings/OrganizationSettings.jsx - Company profile form (name, logo placeholder upload area, contact email, phone, address), currency selector (ZAR/GBP dropdown), fiscal year config (start month dropdown), branding section (primary color picker, theme toggle). All fields editable and persist to AppContext/localStorage on save.

Create src/components/settings/PipelineConfiguration.jsx - Sortable list of pipeline stages using @dnd-kit/core and @dnd-kit/sortable (follow pattern: DndContext, SortableContext, useSortable hook). Each stage card shows name, default duration, SLA threshold. Add/remove stages with buttons. Stage transition rules editor (checkboxes showing which stages can follow which). Notification toggle per stage. Persist reordering to localStorage.

Create src/components/settings/UserManagement.jsx - Users table (name, email, role, status, last active). Role permissions matrix as a grid/table (rows = roles, columns = modules like Dashboard/Nurses/Acquisition/Cohorts/Outreach/Placements/Analytics/Settings, cells = checkboxes). Invite user form (name, email, role dropdown - mock only, adds to list). User activity log table (timestamp, user, action, detail).

Create src/components/settings/IntegrationSettings.jsx - API Keys section: table of keys (name, key masked, created date, status) with Generate and Revoke buttons. Webhook config section: form with URL input, events multi-select, secret field, test webhook button. Third-party integrations list: cards for OET Portal, NHS Jobs, LinkedIn each with connected/disconnected status indicator (green/red dot) and Connect/Disconnect toggle button. Data import/export section: file upload area for import, export button that triggers mock CSV download.

Create src/components/settings/NotificationPreferences.jsx - Email notification toggles section: toggle switches for each event type (Nurse Applied, OET Result Received, Placement Match Found, Cohort Milestone Reached, Document Expiring, Stage SLA Breach). In-app notification toggles (same events). Digest frequency radio buttons (Real-time, Daily, Weekly). Quiet hours config: enable toggle, start time picker, end time picker.

Create src/pages/Settings.jsx with tab navigation following the exact pattern from Analytics.jsx - TABS array with 5 tabs (Organization/Pipeline/Users/Integrations/Notifications), activeTab state, pill-style tab buttons in gray-100 bar, conditional rendering of sub-components. Use lucide icons: Building2 for Organization, GitBranch for Pipeline, Users for User Management, Puzzle for Integrations, Bell for Notifications.
Add Settings route to src/App.jsx: import Settings from './pages/Settings' and add <Route path='/settings' element={<Settings />} /> after the analytics route
Add Settings nav item to src/components/layout/Sidebar.jsx: import Settings icon from lucide-react, add { path: '/settings', label: 'Settings', icon: Settings } as the last item in NAV_ITEMS array
acceptance_criteria: Navigating to /settings shows the Settings page with 5 tab buttons
Organization tab displays editable company profile fields, currency selector, fiscal year config, and branding options
Pipeline tab shows a drag-and-drop sortable list of pipeline stages with add/remove capability and transition rules
Users tab shows user list, permissions matrix grid, invite form, and activity log
Integrations tab shows API keys table, webhook config form, third-party integration cards, and import/export section
Notifications tab shows email and in-app toggles per event, digest frequency radios, and quiet hours config
Settings link appears in the sidebar with the Settings lucide icon
All settings changes persist to localStorage and survive page reload
npm run build completes without errors
npm run lint completes without errors
verification: npm run build exits with code 0
npm run lint exits with code 0
